summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but unverified: I did not run tests, per instructions. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base style "json.", combined brace/literal/number/str pattern); rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or NullHighlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, __rich__ returns text) plus a guarded __main__ CLI with soft_wrap printing and a stderr "Unable to read" error with exit -1; rich/default_styles.py adds six json.* styles; rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print (lazy import); rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json delegating to get_console(); docs/source/console.rst gets a "Printing JSON" section, new reference/json.rst is linked from reference.rst, and CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added gets an entry; tests/test_json.py adds a truecolor console test with hand-derived ANSI expectations and a package-level test using a monkeypatched global console. Choices to confirm: overflow is set to Python None per "overflow to none" (not "ignore"); the CLI imports Console inside the __main__ block. Nothing was committed.
